description: This file defines the keyIndex data structure and associated methods for managing revisions of keys in the etcd MVCC storage layer, including operations like put, restore, tombstone, get, and compact.

classes.name: keyIndex
classes.description: Represents a key's revision history with multiple generations and methods to manipulate revisions.

classes.name: generation
classes.description: Represents a set of revisions for a key, including creation revision, version, and list of revisions.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a revision to the keyIndex, updating generations and modified revision.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores the keyIndex with specified creation and modification revisions and version.

methods.name: restoreTombstone
methods.description: Restores a tombstone revision for the key, indicating deletion.

methods.name: tombstone
methods.description: Adds a tombstone revision to the keyIndex, creating a new empty generation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the modified and created revisions and version at a specific revision point.

methods.name: since
methods.description: Returns revisions since a given revision.

methods.name: compact
methods.description: Removes smaller or equal revisions than a specified revision, cleaning up old versions.

methods.name: keep
methods.description: Determines which revisions to keep during compaction.

methods.name: doCompact
methods.description: Performs the core logic of compacting revisions up to a specific revision.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the keyIndex has no revisions.

methods.name: findGeneration
methods.description: Finds the generation that a specific revision belongs to.

methods.name: Less
methods.description: Compares two keyIndex objects based on their key bytes.

methods.name: equal
methods.description: Checks if two keyIndex objects are equal.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the keyIndex.
